text: Completed Co-Op at Johnson &Johnson; Resumed Fall 2026 Semester at the University of Georgia, Athens.
Presented "High-throughput screening to enable structural and functional studies of AprL in apramycin biosynthesis" at ACS Fall 2026, Chicago.
Appointed President of the Johnson & Johnson Spring House Intern & Co-Op Association, after previously serving as Vice President.

Presented "Optimizing PGC LC Ion Mobility Mass Spectrometry for Structural Characterization of Cancer-Related N-Linked Glycans" as a poster and poster highlight talk at Cancer Glyco X-2026, Van Andel Institute.
Presented "Structural and Mechanistic Characterization of AprL, a PLP-Dependent Aminotransferase in Apramycin Biosynthesis" at ACS Spring 2026, Atlanta.
Advanced to PhD candidacy at the University of Georgia, Athens
Named one of three finalists for the 2026 Women in Chemicals Woman of the Year Award.
Featured in Independent Newspaper Nigeria: "Bridging Molecular Science And Global Health: New Framework For Antibiotic Stewardship."
Featured in The Sun Nigeria: "The Enzyme Revolution: Advancing Green Chemistry Through Protein Science."
Featured in THISDAYLIVE: "Oluwaseun Ajayi: Using High-Throughput Tech to Tackle Antibiotic Resistance."
Elected as a Full Member of Sigma Xi, The Scientific Research Honor Society; featured in Independent Newspaper Nigeria and AuthorityNGR.
Featured in Vanguard News: "From Nigeria to the U.S.: Trailblazing Leadership in Antibiotic Resistance Science."
